svg.text: simple with a gateway: the laboratory published at the facility Service, reached over TLS alone - example/kubernetes
Cluster: kind, name spva-lab, namespace spva-lab. Cilium is the network plugin.
The segments below are NetworkPolicy, enforced by Cilium; the default CNI of kind does not enforce policy at all.

g.text: and the rest of the image database
Mints its own authority at first start:
conf and pvlist from ConfigMap gateway-config
issuer id, read back after the authority
exists; pods roll to mount it
Keychains and the database outlive their
pods, so a restart is the same holder

svg.text: gateway pod - forwards PVAccess across the boundary
Service - a stable name and ports in front of a pod
cluster objects - ConfigMaps, claims, policies, notes
Service selects pod - a short solid arrow
PVA search and data on the lab segment
the outside path in - pvas:// over TLS alone
pvas:// : a PVAccess name server address, over TLS
ClusterIP : a Service address that exists only
app=, zone= : pod labels. A Service picks its pod
by app; a NetworkPolicy admits by zone
A Service name resolves inside the cluster, so the
address lists name Services, not addresses.
PVA : PVAccess, the EPICS network protocol
conf, pvlist : the gateway configuration files
A line claims attachment. Arrowheads appear only
The outside workstation cannot ask the certificate
manager about its own certificate, so it is told
